title: Connecting Africa
description: The International Energy Agency has found that nearly two billion people globally still cook using wood, charcoal and other polluting fuels, and roughly half of them live in Africa. Its "Clean Cooking in Africa 2026" report also found that household air pollution contributes to around 2.5 million premature deaths globally each year. We look at some of the solutions and technologies being developed to solve its clean-cooking crisis.

title: Inside Africa
description: On Dakar's Atlantic coastline, surfing is more than a sport. A growing community of young surfers is finding confidence, opportunity and ambition in the waves. Through three rising talents, we explore how Senegal's surf culture is developing from a close-knit coastal community into a pathway to international competition, as the country prepares to showcase the sport at Dakar 2026 - the Youth Olympic Games.

title: Innovate
description: Much of the debate around AI centers on the jobs it could take; however, in health and human care, there often aren't enough people to do the work; meet AI agents and robots filling those gaps in hospitals, companionship and physical support; can they help without replacing human connection and judgment?
